writing.review: The production Markdown editor types and saves writing; formatting and spelling stay available without extending the short tour.

alternatives.review: The real alternatives sidebar, squiggle, option dots and keyboard switching are exercised.

ghosts.review: Set aside and revive remain in the production editing tools; omitted from the short tour to keep customization the focus.

overflow.review: The real overflow editor keeps spare writing through personal, official and reset updates.

documents.review: The demo saves through the production editor using isolated memory; personal Mac files and native export are outside the browser tour.

assistance.review: The production alternatives UI is shared; live model generation and sign-in are not run on the public website.

personal-updates.review: The real Preferences, queued features and official-update card show building personal features, retaining them through an official update, and returning to official Draft without changing writing. External agent execution, packaging and restarts are simulated.

images.review: Pasting images and cropping them from the image panel use the production editor; omitted from the short tour to keep customization the focus. The demo keeps pasted images in memory instead of the Mac document folder.
